exposure: not availing minimum recommended antenatal checkups
delay of > 48 hours between diagnosis and hospital admission
cohort: Neonates born between March 2019 and February 2020 with venous blood total serum bilirubin (TSB) >= 15 mg/dL (cases) or TSB of 10 to 14.9 mg/dL (controls) at admission.
finding: Low maternal education, residence in rural areas, not utilizing recommended antenatal checkups, not using Matri Yan, home delivery, and delayed hospitalization were associated with increased risk of severe jaundice.
